final: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS rel FROM budget GROUP BY category), avgn AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS a FROM cat) SELECT AVG(rel) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(n) AS avg_lines, AVG(n - (SELECT a FROM avgn)) AS avg_excess_lines FROM cat WHERE n > (SELECT a FROM avgn)
